description: WHEN TO USE: To see which competitor brands were mentioned by LLMs in responses to this project's prompts. Shows competitive landscape as seen by AI models. REQUIRES: project_id from lbm_list_projects. RETURNS: Compact CSV with competitor name, mention count, frequency % (default limit: 20). Set include_all_fields=true for full JSON. Pass higher limit only if user explicitly asks for more.

include_all_fields.description: Set true for full JSON response. Default: false (compact CSV — recommended).

tags.description: Optional: filter by comma-separated prompt tags

name: lbm_list_competitors
